gizmo.title: Uluhlu lokujonga olunamachaphaza
gizmo.description: Uluhlu lweebhokisi zokukhangela. Abafundi bayaphawula izinto kwaye inkqubela yabo ikhunjulwa kwisixhobo sabo.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Igama loluhlu. Lifundwa ngokuvakalayo njengelebhile yeqela leebhokisi zokukhangela.

configure.title: Izinto
configure.description: Into nganye yibhokisi yokukhangela. Izinto eziphawuliweyo okanye ezivaliweyo azinakutshintshwa ngabafundi.

configure.title: Ezinamanani
configure.description: Bonisa uluhlu olunamanani endaweni yoluhlu olunamachaphaza.

developer.title: I-id yokugcina
developer.description: I-id ekhethekileyo esetyenziswa ukukhumbula inkqubela yomfundi kwisixhobo sakhe. Yenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo; yitshintshe kuphela ukwabelana ngenkqubela phakathi kwezintlu okanye ukuqala ngokutsha.
